api: topologies.training.losses:get_loss('soft-dtw')(logits_or_prediction, targets, *, ignore_index=None, reduction='mean', **params); params accepts gamma
description: Raw soft-DTW with squared-Euclidean local costs and the soft-min dynamic program (Cuturi & Blondel, §2.1 Eq. (2) and Algorithm 1; §2.2 following Eq. (3)); batch reductions follow src/topologies/implementations/training/core.py:70-76.

examples.title: Train a sequence regressor with soft-DTW

name: Soft-DTW loss

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts gamma only; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because continuous sequence targets do not use indexed-label masking
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point sequences shaped [B, N] or [B, N, D], with nonempty batch and sequence dimensions
parameters.reduction: none returns one raw score per sample, mean averages batch scores, or sum totals them (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point sequences shaped [B, M] or [B, M, D], matching prediction batch, feature dimension, dtype, and device; M may differ from N
